$comment: Single source of truth for how this app identifies itself.
Consumed by capacitor.config.ts (native), vite.config.ts (PWA manifest) and
src/appIdentity.ts (in-app About/version display).
appId is PROVISIONAL. Confirm it before production signing or store submission:
once an Android package name or iOS bundle identifier is published it cannot be
changed without shipping a different app. It deliberately contains no reference
to Nova Scotia government, RMV or Access Nova Scotia, so it cannot be read as
implying official affiliation.
description: An independent, unofficial study aid for the Nova Scotia Class 7 Learner's Licence knowledge test.

$comment: Where the web app is deployed. Deployment configuration, not application
architecture: nothing in src/ reads this, and the app stays host-agnostic.
`customDomain` is what makes the production build a ROOT deployment. When it is
set, the Pages workflow builds with VITE_BASE_PATH=/ instead of deriving a
project-site subpath from the repository name. Clear it and the workflow falls
back to whatever GitHub Pages reports — which is how a fork gets a working
https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/ deployment with no edits.
`productionUrl` is used only for the canonical and og:url tags in the built
HTML, so the same page reachable at the apex, at www and at the old project
URL declares one address. Override at build time with SITE_URL.
The custom domain itself is configured in the repository's Settings -> Pages.
That is deliberately the ONLY mechanism: this project ships no CNAME file, so
there is nothing that can disagree with the setting. See docs/OPEN_SOURCE_RELEASE.md.
Font Awesome Pro hosted Kit, used by the deployed web app under the maintainer's
Font Awesome Pro licence.
A Kit id is a public, client-side identifier — it is designed to appear in page
markup — so it is not a secret and is not treated as one. What must never enter
this repository is Pro icon ARTWORK: path data, SVG files, webfonts or the Pro
npm packages. `pnpm release:audit` enforces that distinction.
A fork should point this at its own Kit. Contributors without a Pro licence can
still run and develop the app: the Kit simply does not load, icon boxes stay
reserved, and every control keeps its text label.
Override at build time with FA_KIT_URL if you need a different Kit without
editing this file.
